meta.description: Reviewed localized printed card names. An exact-print observation of a card release wins; otherwise a card whose English name is only the species takes the localization's official species name. A pattern listed in derivedPatternCardNames is applied per localization by owner decision; every other mechanic or trainer-owned name (ex, GX, V, VMAX, LV.X, Team Rocket's, Eevee & Snorlax, Doll) is never derived and its pattern is retained as reference only.
